token.meaning: Printable, non-whitespace token passed only on stdin. The stream accepts this field from an object payload, or a flat object token or raw token line instead. Total stream bound is 65536 characters.

file.meaning: Logical token path once replaced, not its contents.

restart.meaning: The unit-control receipt, skipped under scratch, or null before restart.

restarted.meaning: The live agent restart was confirmed; false in scratch mode.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Whether the token file was replaced, even if restart or deed later fails.

final.meaning: Contains ok, signal and mutationPerformed. The slash-form stdin stream does not receive the outer front-door stamp.

timestamp.meaning: UTC ISO timestamp added by the receipt emitter.

host.meaning: Local hostname added by the receipt emitter.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Intake, file operation, restart or deed outcome.
